title: 第三章满朝震惊眼神狂变第四章贿赂县令若金子里面是铜呢
slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: 高阳这话响起，百官全都被吓了一跳。
他们纷纷瞪大眼睛看向高阳。
短短几句话，便让他们感到了彻骨的寒意。
先送他碎银几两，放他离去，再看他投奔何方亲友，一并除之。
甚至小男孩忽然出现，不符常理，要严查床底，米缸，衣柜。
动手时，左右胸前各一刀，务必一击必死！
狠！
太狠了！
王忠一脸惊惧的看向高阳，内心狂震。
“高家百年将门，还有这等阴险的后辈？”
“这若让他掌权，老王家的蚯蚓岂不是都要被劈成两半？”
别说王忠了，哪怕是高峰都感受到了一股寒意。
这些话，竟然出自他的儿子高阳？
一时间，文武百官的目光都齐齐盯着高阳。
大乾右威卫大将军秦振国开口道，“陛下，高侍郎之子所言，不无道理，若小男孩他爹懂得斩草要除根，也不会有如今灭门之祸。”
“末将赞同。”
此话，也令武曌回过神来。
她目光看向扫去，绝美的脸上带着一股饶有兴趣。
这一道题说难不难，说简单也不简单，最主要就是大乾仁义成风，被规矩，世俗束缚的太多。
若真是报灭门之仇，别说是小男孩，恐怕仇家府邸里的蚂蚁都要砍成两半。
但只是假如的话，为了所谓的仁义道德和名声，很少有人会当众选择斩草除根。
更别说如高阳这种，先给碎银几两，看他投奔哪个亲友，一并除之。
甚至小男孩忽然出现，只是她随口一说，连她都没有深想。
但高阳连这一点都注意到了，小男孩的忽然出现，又是在保护谁呢？
斩草不除根，令自已和家人陷入危险之中。
这在武曌的眼中，是一件十分愚蠢的事情。
这个高阳，有点意思。
“斩草不除根，春风吹又生，小男孩的父亲若狠下心斩草除根，又岂有今日之祸？”
“你的第一题回答，朕很满意。”
武曌的第一句话是对百官说的，第二句则是看向高阳说的。
高峰一脸诧异。
这孽子令女帝陛下很满意？
虽然高峰很有些难以置信，但这对高家来说是一件好事。
武曌目光看向高阳，淡淡道，“第一个问题，只是朕的小小考验。”
content_en:
When Gao Yang's words came out, all the officials were startled.
They all looked at Gao Yang with wide eyes.
Just a few words gave them a chill to their bones.
Give him a few taels of broken silver first, then let him go, and then see where he will go to his relatives and friends, and get rid of them all.
Even a little boy suddenly appeared, which was unreasonable, and he had to check the bottom of the bed, the rice vat, and the wardrobe.
When you strike, strike with a knife on the left and right sides of the chest. Be sure to kill him with one blow!
ruthless!
Too cruel!
Wang Zhong looked at Gao Yang with a horrified look on his face, his heart shaking wildly.
"The Gao family has been a general for a hundred years, and there are such insidious descendants?"
"If he is allowed to take power, wouldn't all the earthworms in the Wang family be split in half?"
Not to mention Wang Zhong, even Gao Feng felt a chill.
These words actually came from his son Gao Yang?
For a moment, all the civil and military officials stared at Gao Yang.
Qin Zhenguo, the general of Daqian Youweiwei, said, "Your Majesty, what the son of Gao Shilang said is not unreasonable. If the little boy's father knew how to cut the weeds and get rid of the roots, there would not be the disaster of annihilating the family now."
"The general agrees."
These words also brought Wu Zhao back to his senses.
She glanced over, with a look of interest on her beautiful face.
This question is neither difficult nor simple. The most important thing is that benevolence and righteousness are common practice and are too restricted by rules and worldliness.
If he really wanted to avenge his family's destruction, let alone a little boy, I'm afraid all the ants in the enemy's mansion would be cut in half.
But just if that is the case, few people would choose to eradicate the roots in public for the sake of so-called benevolence, morality and reputation.
Not to mention someone like Gao Yang, who would first give a few taels of broken silver to see which relative or friend he would defect to, and get rid of them all.
Even when the little boy suddenly appeared, she just said it casually without thinking deeply about it.
But Gao Yang even noticed this. Who was the little boy protecting when he suddenly appeared?
Cutting the grass without eradicating the roots puts you and your family in danger.
In Wu Zhao's eyes, this was a very stupid thing.
This Gao Yang is a bit interesting.
"Cut the weeds but not the roots, and the spring breeze will bring new growth. If the little boy's father had determined to cut the weeds and remove the roots, how could he have suffered today's disaster?"
"I am very satisfied with your answer to the first question."
Wu Zhao's first sentence was to the officials, and his second sentence was to Gao Yang.
Gao Feng looked surprised.
Is this scoundrel very satisfied with Her Majesty the Empress?
Although Gao Feng is a bit unbelievable, this is a good thing for the Gao family.
Wu Zhao looked at Gao Yang and said calmly, "The first question is just a small test for me."
title_en: Chapter 3: The whole court was shocked and their eyes changed wildly. Chapter 4: Bribing the magistrate: What if the gold contained copper?
